items.title: 審計時代要來了？香港證監會將虛擬資產平台納入傳統證券審計監管
items.title_en: Is an Auditing Era Coming? Hong Kong's Securities Regulator Brings Virtual Asset Platforms Under Traditional Securities Audit Oversight
paras: 香港證券及期貨事務監察委員會(SFC)與會計及財務匯報局(AFRC)周一(28日)聯合簽署新版合作備忘錄，正式將獲牌虛擬資產交易平台(VATP)等機構納入與傳統證券公司相同的財務匯報與審計監管框架。此舉意味著香港數位資產市場正由初期的發牌准入，延伸至更為嚴謹的財務穿透與日常監管。
本次備忘錄的覆蓋範圍從傳統上市實體，擴展至獲SFC發牌的虛擬資產服務提供者、持牌法團、認可基金及開放式基金型公司，同時包含核數師(審計師)所執行的審計與鑑證工作。
雙方建立起資訊共享、案件轉介、相互協助及協調檢查等機制。若審計過程發現財務風險訊號，可直接觸發證券監管執法動作；反之，監管檢查發現的問題也可延伸調查審計師的執業品質，要求虛擬資產業者遵循一致的編帳與審計紀律。
在穩定幣與整體監管佈局方面，香港《穩定幣條例》已於2025年8月1日實施，金管局於2026年4月10日發放首批穩定幣發行人牌照。監管條例規定，發行人須聘用認可之獨立外部審計師定期核證儲備資產與發行面值。
結合2023年6月生效的VATP發牌制度(至2026年4月持牌平台增至約12家)以及規劃於2026年提交立法會的託管監察法案，本次備忘錄補齊了會計審計穿透的關鍵環節。
相較於美國《數位資產市場清晰法案》(CLARITY Act)於2026年9月在參議院遭到卡關、主管機關轉而依靠行政豁免的做法，香港選擇以跨機關合作備忘錄快速平移傳統金融的監管經驗。
paras_en: The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) and the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council (AFRC) jointly signed a new memorandum of understanding on Monday (the 28th), formally bringing licensed virtual asset trading platforms (VATPs) and similar entities into the same financial reporting and audit regulatory framework as traditional securities firms. This move signals that Hong Kong’s digital asset market is moving from an initial licensing entry stage to a more rigorous financial transparency and ongoing supervision regime.

The scope of the memorandum expands from traditional listed entities to include SFC‑licensed virtual asset service providers, licensed corporations, recognized funds and open‑ended fund companies, and also covers the audit and assurance work performed by auditors.

The two parties have established mechanisms for information sharing, case referrals, mutual assistance and coordinated inspections. If audit procedures uncover financial risk signals, regulatory enforcement actions can be triggered directly; conversely, issues identified in supervisory inspections can lead to investigations of auditors’ practice quality, requiring virtual‑asset operators to adhere to consistent accounting and audit discipline.

Regarding stablecoins and the overall regulatory framework, Hong Kong’s Stablecoin Ordinance came into effect on 1 August 2025, and the Monetary Authority issued the first stablecoin issuer licences on 10 April 2026. The regulation mandates that issuers engage an approved independent external auditor to regularly verify reserve assets and the issued face value.

Combining the VATP licensing regime that took effect in June 2023 (with the number of licensed platforms expected to rise to about 12 by April 2026) and the custodial supervision bill slated for submission to the Legislative Council in 2026, the new memorandum fills a critical gap in accounting and audit transparency.

Compared with the United States, where the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act) stalled in the Senate in September 2026 and regulators resorted to administrative exemptions, Hong Kong has chosen to swiftly transpose traditional financial regulatory experience through an inter‑agency cooperation memorandum.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉受惠星鏈衛星題材、光通訊產品量產 穩懋衝上漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Benefiting from Starlink Satellite Theme and Mass Production of Optical Communication Products, Wenmao Hits Upper Limit
paras: 砷化鎵三五大廠穩懋(3105-TW)受惠於SpaceX(SPCX-US)最大型火箭「星艦」於本(9)月28日從美國德州發射場起飛，首度成功進入地球軌道，加上第3季起高階手機拉貨強勁，今(30)日開高走高，盤中在大單敲進下，亮燈攻上漲停價542元，成交量爆增至4萬張以上，股價不僅站上所有均線，也創近3個月來波段新高。
外電指出，SpaceX至今已完成部署26顆迄今最先進的星鏈衛星，未來單次發射成本有望大幅降低，也意味SpaceX未來能以極快速度完成全球高頻寬、低延遲的衛星網路布署。
穩懋除了在第3季起受惠美系高階手機新品拉貨外，AI資料中心帶動1.6T高速光通訊產品放量，加上低軌衛星需求升溫，光通訊及基礎設施業務逐步成為新成長引擎，產品組合也有助於改善後續獲利表現。
法人表示，穩懋衛星相關產品預計在下半年接續放量，產品結構由手機射頻元件延伸到光通訊與航太通訊元件。
外資則表示，穩懋在第3季營收預估將維持低雙位數季增，主要受惠光通訊及基礎建設需求升溫，WiFi業務也因路由器需求回暖，展望由持平上修至季增，公司同時看好航太及非手機光通訊市場後續成長。
穩懋近年除了手機PA產品業務，持續布局光通訊、航太與高階傳輸應用，切入低軌衛星新世代應用，布局衛星間串接功率放大器，延伸至衛星對地面接收站元件，產品自傳統的頻段延伸到E、V頻段，今(2026)年更將推出頻率可達75GHz至110GHz的W頻段功率放大器(PA)，目前也已出貨。
paras_en: GaN (gallium nitride) major manufacturers Wenmao (3105-TW) benefited from SpaceX (SPCX-US) largest rocket "Starship" launching on September 28 from Texas, achieving its first successful entry into Earth orbit. Coupled with strong demand from high‑end smartphones starting in Q3, the stock opened higher on the 30th and, amid large buy orders, surged to the daily limit price of NT$542, with volume exploding to over 40,000 shares. The price not only stayed above all moving averages but also set a new three‑month high for the swing.

Foreign media reported that SpaceX has so far deployed 26 of the most advanced Starlink satellites, and future single‑launch costs are expected to drop dramatically, meaning SpaceX could rapidly roll out a global high‑bandwidth, low‑latency satellite network.

Beyond the Q3 boost from U.S. high‑end smartphone shipments, Wenmao’s AI data‑center business is driving volume for its 1.6‑terabit high‑speed optical communication products. Rising demand for low‑earth‑orbit satellites is turning optical communications and infrastructure into new growth engines, and the product mix should help improve future profitability.

Institutional investors said Wenmao’s satellite‑related products are expected to continue scaling in the second half of the year, expanding the product portfolio from mobile RF components to optical and aerospace communication components.

Foreign investors noted that Wenmao’s Q3 revenue is forecast to maintain low‑double‑digit sequential growth, mainly due to hotter demand for optical communications and infrastructure, with Wi‑Fi business also rebounding as router demand warms. Outlook has been upgraded from flat to sequential growth, and the company remains optimistic about aerospace and non‑mobile optical communication markets.

In recent years, besides its mobile PA product line, Wenmao has been expanding into optical communications, aerospace and high‑end transmission applications, entering the new generation of low‑orbit satellite uses. It is developing inter‑satellite power amplifiers and extending to ground‑station components, broadening frequency coverage from traditional bands to E and V bands. In 2026 it will launch W‑band (75‑110 GHz) power amplifiers, which are already in shipment.

items.title: 今年首家石英元件廠籌資案完成 安碁科技完成3億元面額CB募集
items.title_en: This Year's First Quartz Component Manufacturer Financing Deal Completed; Anqing Technology Completes NT$300 Million Face-Value Convertible Bond Offering
paras: 安碁科技(6174-TW))今(30)日宣布完成3億元面額的無擔保可轉換公債(CB)完成募集，籌款3.06億元，爲今年首家石英元件廠籌資案完成 ，安碁科技的這筆無擔保可轉換公債，預計在10月2日上櫃掛牌交易。
安碁科技的這3億元面額的筆無擔保可轉換公債以102元發行，合計籌款爲3.06億元，轉換價爲46.4元，轉換溢價率爲105.22%。
擴充營運能量中的安碁科技2026年1-6月營收3.64億元，稅後純益3854萬元，年增3.72倍，每股純益0.77元。
安碁科技預計10月7日召開法人說明會。
paras_en: Anqing Technology (6174‑TW) announced today (the 30th) that it has completed the fundraising of an unsecured convertible bond (CB) with a face value of NT$300 million, raising a total of NT$306 million, making it the first financing deal of a quartz component manufacturer this year. The bond is expected to be listed on the over‑the‑counter market on October 2.

The NT$300 million face‑value unsecured convertible bond was issued at NT$102 per bond, resulting in total proceeds of NT$306 million, with a conversion price of NT$46.4 and a conversion premium of 105.22%.

In its operational expansion, Anqing Technology reported revenue of NT$364 million and net profit after tax of NT$38.54 million for the January‑June 2026 period, a year‑over‑year increase of 3.72 times, and earnings per share of NT$0.77.
Anqing Technology plans to hold a corporate briefing for institutional investors on October 7.

items.title: 幫你下單！Robinhood祭出AI交易代理 週末美股24小時交易明年登場
items.title_en: Help You Place Orders! Robinhood Rolls Out AI Trading Agents, 24‑Hour Weekend US Stock Trading to Launch Next Year
paras: Robinhood Markets (HOOD-US) 正大幅擴充面向活躍交易者的產品與交易工具，宣布將把AI代理(AI Agent)直接整合進交易App，讓用戶透過人工智慧分析市場、建立交易策略及執行交易，同時規劃開放部分美股及ETF週末24小時交易，進一步將交易時間延伸至全年全天候。
Robinhood在休士頓舉行的HOOD Summit 2026宣布推出Robinhood Agents，將原本需要具備技術能力、透過第三方AI工具連接Robinhood交易帳戶的功能，改為直接內建於App。用戶可建立專屬AI代理、選擇AI模型，透過對話方式要求Agent研究市場、分析投資組合、建立策略並執行交易。
Robinhood表示，5月推出的Agentic Trading截至目前已有超過15萬名客戶開設Agentic Trading帳戶，AI代理每天使用Robinhood工具的次數接近3000萬次。新推出的Robinhood Agents則將這項能力進一步普及，讓不熟悉AI技術的用戶也能在App內建立及使用AI代理。
新系統將使用獨立的Agentic Trading帳戶，AI代理只能存取用戶配置在該帳戶中的資金。用戶可以選擇是否要求人工核准每筆交易，預設設定為開啟人工核准。此外，Robinhood即將推出名為Loops的功能，允許用戶將交易策略設定為持續執行的指令，例如每天檢查市場並在符合條件時自動下單，甚至在用戶睡眠期間持續執行交易。

Robinhood同時推出AI代理Apps，讓AI代理可以取得更多專業市場數據及分析工具。首批及後續加入的11家數據與工具業者包括Unusual Whales、Nasdaq (NDAQ-US)、SpotGamma、Wendy、Quiver Quantitative、Token Terminal、Visual Crossing、SkyFi、Narravance，以及即將加入的Carbon Arc和Fiscal.ai。部分工具月費介於5美元至30美元不等，所有AI代理Apps均提供1個月免費試用。
Robinhood也宣布將擴大交易時間，計畫在明年初開放部分美股及ETF週末24小時交易，但仍須等待監管審查。週末交易將從精選股票及ETF開始，並適用於各類帳戶，交易基礎設施則由另類交易系統Bruce ATS提供。
這項計畫將延伸Robinhood在2023年推出的24 Hour Market。目前用戶可在美東時間週日晚間8時至週五晚間8時交易數百檔股票及ETF。Reuters指出，Robinhood在推出全天候平日交易功能約10個月後曾表示，在交易最活躍的日子，非傳統交易時段的成交量占每日總交易量最高達25%。此次週末交易則是Robinhood首次把交易服務延伸至週末。
Robinhood表示，週末交易初期將採精選標的模式，待監管審查完成後推出。市場也存在非傳統交易時段流動性較低、價差擴大及價格不確定性提高等問題，因此週末交易的實際涵蓋標的與上線時間仍取決於監管進度。
除了AI及交易時間，Robinhood還宣布推出加密貨幣永續期貨。符合資格的美國客戶未來幾個月可直接透過App交易BTC、ETH、SOL、XRP、DOGE、ADA、LINK及HYPE永續期貨。這些合約沒有到期日，BTC及ETH永續期貨最高可使用10倍槓桿，其餘標的最高為3倍。
相關永續期貨由Robinhood Derivatives透過Bitstamp提供。Robinhood表示，在今年年底前每筆交易收取1個基點(0.01%)費用，並提供停損、止盈、即時清算價格及風險警示等功能。
Robinhood也將擴大預測市場產品，推出與企業財報相關的Earnings Contracts。這類合約將透過Cboe提供，讓符合資格且取得選擇權交易權限的用戶，針對企業特定財務或營運指標進行交易，例如企業是否超越財報預期、營收是否達到特定目標或是否跨越特定財務門檻。
與傳統股票交易不同，這類二元KPI選擇權的結算依據並非公司股價，而是企業向美國證券交易委員會提交的財報中所揭露的特定財務或營運指標。每份合約最高支付1美元，Robinhood及Cboe均表示今年年底前暫不收取合約相關費用，但產品仍須接受監管審查。
在其他交易功能方面，Robinhood將從10月起延長熱門標的的選擇權交易時間，交易時段將從上午7時30分延長至下午4時15分，官方估計整體交易時間增加35%。公司也將在10月推出股票OCO(One-Cancels-the-Other)訂單，讓用戶同時設定止盈及停損價格，其中一筆訂單成交後，另一筆將自動取消，選擇權版本預計明年初推出。
此外，Robinhood預計下月將讓符合資格的保證金客戶選擇啟用最高4倍的盤中購買力，較目前最高2倍提高。公司也設置收盤前推播通知及首次啟用時的App提醒。
Robinhood Social也將從今年稍早的測試階段擴大至所有符合資格的美國客戶。新功能包括分享加密貨幣及股票圖表、投資組合配置與損益，並預計配合第三季財報季推出即時財報功能，讓用戶觀看財報電話會議並在過程中進行交易。
Robinhood此次大幅擴充產品，反映其持續將服務重心延伸至活躍交易者。公司希望透過AI代理、全天候交易、永續期貨、財報合約及更多專業數據工具，把過去較常見於對沖基金、量化交易機構及大型金融機構的交易工具整合到零售投資平台。
不過，Robinhood也在產品揭露中強調，AI代理可能誤解指令、使用不完整或過時資訊，或以用戶未預期的方式執行交易。若用戶關閉人工核准功能，AI代理可在沒有逐筆確認的情況下自行下單；Loops啟動後也可能在用戶未操作App甚至睡眠期間自動建立、修改或取消交易，因此相關交易損益及自動化規則仍由用戶自行承擔責任。
Robinhood同時指出，延長交易時段可能面臨較低流動性、更高波動率、更大買賣價差及價格不確定性等風險，而AI交易亦涉及第三方大型語言模型的資料政策及監管、隱私與資安問題。週末股票交易目前仍等待監管審查，AI代理及其他新產品的實際推出時間與適用客戶範圍也可能因監管及技術因素調整。
paras_en: Robinhood Markets (HOOD-US) is dramatically expanding products and tools for active traders, announcing that AI Agents will be integrated directly into its trading app, allowing users to leverage artificial intelligence to analyze markets, build trading strategies and execute trades, while also planning to open weekend 24‑hour trading for select US stocks and ETFs next year, extending trading to all‑day, all‑year availability.

At the HOOD Summit 2026 in Houston, Robinhood unveiled Robinhood Agents, moving the capability that previously required technical skill and third‑party AI tools to connect to a Robinhood account into a built‑in app feature. Users can create a personal AI agent, choose an AI model, and via conversation ask the agent to research the market, analyze portfolios, devise strategies and place trades.

Robinhood said that since the Agentic Trading launch in May, more than 150,000 customers have opened Agentic Trading accounts, and AI agents are used nearly 30 million times per day with Robinhood tools. The new Robinhood Agents will broaden this capability so users unfamiliar with AI can create and use agents within the app.

The new system will use a separate Agentic Trading account, and the AI agent can only access funds allocated to that account. Users may opt to require manual approval for each trade, which is enabled by default. Robinhood will also roll out a feature called Loops that lets users set strategies as continuously running instructions, such as checking the market daily and automatically placing orders when conditions are met, even while the user sleeps.

Robinhood is also launching AI Agent Apps that give agents access to more professional market data and analytics tools. The first batch and subsequent additions include eleven data and tool providers such as Unusual Whales, Nasdaq (NDAQ-US), SpotGamma, Wendy, Quiver Quantitative, Token Terminal, Visual Crossing, SkyFi, Narravance, and upcoming additions Carbon Arc and Fiscal.ai. Monthly fees for some tools range from $5 to $30, and all AI Agent Apps come with a one‑month free trial.

Robinhood also announced it will expand trading hours, planning to open weekend 24‑hour trading for select US stocks and ETFs early next year, pending regulatory review. Weekend trading will start with a curated list of stocks and ETFs, will be available to all account types, and the underlying trading infrastructure will be provided by the alternative trading system Bruce ATS.

The plan extends Robinhood’s 24‑Hour Market launched in 2023. Currently users can trade hundreds of stocks and ETFs from 8 p.m. ET on Sunday to 8 p.m. ET on Friday. Reuters noted that about ten months after introducing all‑day weekday trading, Robinhood said non‑traditional session volume can account for up to 25 % of daily volume on the busiest days. The upcoming weekend trading marks Robinhood’s first extension of trading services into the weekend.

Robinhood said the initial weekend trading will follow a selected‑securities model and will roll out after regulatory clearance. The market acknowledges that non‑traditional session liquidity can be lower, spreads wider and price uncertainty higher, so the actual coverage and launch timing will depend on regulatory progress.

Beyond AI and extended hours, Robinhood announced perpetual crypto futures. Qualified US customers will soon be able to trade BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, ADA, LINK and HYPE perpetual futures directly in the app. These contracts have no expiry; BTC and ETH perpetuals can be leveraged up to 10 ×, while the other assets allow up to 3 × leverage.

The perpetual futures are offered by Robinhood Derivatives through Bitstamp. Robinhood said it will charge a fee of one basis point (0.01 %) per trade through the end of the year and will provide stop‑loss, take‑profit, real‑time liquidation prices and risk‑alert features.

Robinhood will also expand its predictive‑market products with Earnings Contracts tied to corporate earnings. These contracts, delivered via Cboe, will let eligible users with options‑trading permission trade on specific financial or operational metrics of a company, such as beating earnings expectations, hitting revenue targets or crossing a defined financial threshold.

Unlike traditional equity options, settlement of these binary KPI contracts is based not on the stock price but on the specific metric disclosed in the company’s filing with the SEC. Each contract pays up to $1. Robinhood and Cboe said no contract fees will be charged through year‑end, though the product remains subject to regulatory review.

In other trading features, Robinhood will extend options trading hours for popular symbols from 7:30 a.m. to 4:15 p.m. starting in October, an estimated 35 % increase in overall trading time. The firm will also launch stock OCO (One‑Cancels‑the‑Other) orders in October, allowing users to set simultaneous profit‑taking and stop‑loss prices; the options version is slated for early next year.

Additionally, Robinhood expects to let eligible margin customers select up to 4 × intraday buying power next month, up from the current 2 × maximum. The company is also adding pre‑close push notifications and an app reminder at first use.

Robinhood Social will expand from its early‑year testing phase to all qualified US customers. New features include sharing crypto and stock charts, portfolio allocations and P&L, and a real‑time earnings feature slated for Q3 earnings season that lets users watch earnings calls and trade during the webcast.

This sweeping product expansion reflects Robinhood’s ongoing shift toward serving active traders. The company aims to bring AI agents, all‑day trading, perpetual futures, earnings contracts and a suite of professional data tools—traditionally found at hedge funds, quant shops and large institutions—into a retail investing platform.

However, Robinhood cautions that AI agents may misinterpret commands, use incomplete or outdated information, or execute trades in ways users did not anticipate. If users disable manual approval, agents can place orders without per‑trade confirmation; once Loops are active, they may automatically create, modify or cancel trades even when the user is not in the app or is sleeping, so users bear all resulting profit‑and‑loss and automation‑rule responsibility.

Robinhood also notes that extending trading hours can bring lower liquidity, higher volatility, wider spreads and greater price uncertainty, and that AI trading raises issues around third‑party large‑language‑model data policies, regulation, privacy and cybersecurity. Weekend stock trading still awaits regulatory approval, and the rollout timing and eligible‑customer scope for AI agents and other new products may shift due to regulatory or technical factors.

items.title: 小摩轉「戰術性看多」美股！五大理由曝光：科技、半導體成核心布局
paras: 摩根大通（JPMorgan）機構市場情報交易台（Market Intel Desk）近期將美股短線觀點，從「戰術性謹慎／中性」調整為「戰術性看多」，並認為當前市場風險報酬比已明顯改善。
根據最新報告，該交易台此次轉向主要建立在5項因素，包括宏觀基本面優於預期、消費者展現韌性、企業獲利預期可能偏低、債券殖利率趨於穩定，以及技術面改善。
策略方面，該交易台也調整原本的多那斯達克100指數（NDX）、空羅素2000指數（RTY）配對交易，改以衍生品工具表達相關市場觀點。
摩根大通機構市場情報交易台上一次調整立場是在8月31日，當時由看多轉為「戰術性謹慎／中性」，考量因素包括聯準會（Fed）政策不確定性、部位配置、信用利差擴大、季節性因素，以及動能因子回落。
當時該團隊建議採取多NDX、空RTY的配對交易。
自8月底調整觀點以來，標普500指數大致持平，但上述多NDX／空RTY配對交易累計上漲逾8%，美股整體表現也優於其他主要市場。
在此背景下，該交易台如今重新轉向戰術性看多，顯示其認為短期市場風險與潛在報酬之間的條件已出現變化。

五大理由支撐美股短線看多

摩根大通交易台在最新報告中列出5項主要理由。
首先，宏觀基本面優於預期。最新初值PMI顯示經濟成長強於市場預期，可能進一步支撐就業、消費及企業獲利。
該團隊指出，標普500每股盈餘（EPS）成長與名目GDP增速的關聯更為密切，因此目前市場對企業獲利的預期可能相對保守。
其次，消費者韌性仍高於預期。儘管市場此前擔憂通膨及高利率可能壓抑消費，但實際消費數據持續優於預期，使「K型復甦」的相關假設受到挑戰；同時，勞動市場改善也持續支撐消費表現。
第三，企業獲利預期可能仍有上修空間。2026年第2季EPS成長率達52%，目前市場預估第3季約成長29%。摩根大通交易台認為，這項預測可能偏低，因標普500 11大產業目前均預期實現營收及EPS正成長。
第四，美債殖利率可能趨於穩定。摩根大通利率策略師Jay Barry預估，10年期美債殖利率未來1個月將從5.18%小幅升至5.20%，之後年底回落至5.05%。若殖利率波動降低，可能有助於緩解股市部分下行壓力。
第五，技術面持續改善。報告認為，季節性因素轉向有利，加上散戶投資人參與度可能提高，而目前整體市場持倉相對輕盈，為股市提供進一步上行空間。

PCE、就業數據與AI題材成近期焦點

除了基本面因素外，摩根大通交易台也列出近期可能影響市場的數據及事件。
通膨方面，本週將公布PCE及ISM製造業數據，其中ISM製造業價格支付分項被視為重要的前瞻性通膨指標，服務業價格支付分項的影響則更為明顯。若數據顯示通膨壓力高於預期，可能造成殖利率曲線出現熊市平坦化。
後續CPI將於10月14日公布，聯準會則預計於10月28日召開利率會議。
就業市場方面，若就業數據持續改善，將有助於強化經濟成長及消費的相關論述，但在目前市場定價下，強勁就業數據也可能重新推升升息預期，形成「好消息就是壞消息」的市場反應。
AI題材則仍是市場關注焦點。Meta旗下Muse發布，以及本週OpenAI開發者日、美光科技（MU）財報，都將成為AI產業後續發展的重要觀察窗口。

科技仍是核心多頭　半導體、「美股七巨頭」受關注

在投資策略上，科技產業仍是摩根大通交易台的核心多頭部位，但團隊不再建議透過放空RTY進行對沖。
報告指出，若油價及殖利率進一步走低，可能引發RTY軋空，因此相關風險敞口較適合透過衍生品工具表達。
科技產業內部則可能出現進一步分化，摩根大通預期半導體及「美股七巨頭」成分股有機會跑贏整體科技產業。
軟體股目前尚未形成市場共識，但人氣正在逐步累積，被該團隊視為非共識性的看多機會；至於AI題材，團隊仍認為其具延續性，建議持續持有相關曝險。
科技以外，摩根大通認為周期性產業若要出現持續性反彈，需要看到殖利率曲線轉向牛市陡峭化。在非AI領域中，銀行股則受到關注，原因包括經濟重啟、殖利率曲線可能陡峭化，以及資本市場前景改善。
對於房地產、電信及公用事業等利率敏感型產業，該交易台認為雖可能參與軋空行情，但整體而言仍可能持續落後標普500，AI相關標的除外。
此外，報告指出，若美伊達成協議，可能推動歐股及RTY大幅上漲；航空、汽車、郵輪、非必需消費及飯店等疫情後復甦題材也值得關注，並建議優先透過選擇權布局。

轉多仍伴隨風險　聯準會政策成關鍵變數

儘管短線觀點轉向看多，摩根大通交易台仍列出多項中長期風險。
其中包括債券市場是否低估此次聯準會升息周期的終點。若經濟如初值PMI所顯示，以5%的實質成長速度擴張，同時通膨壓力持續、就業市場改善並推升薪資通膨，聯準會可能需要採取更積極的升息路徑。
市場另外也需觀察，是否開始反映聯準會在某次會議升息50個基點的可能性，以及農產品通膨何時傳導至核心通膨。
此外，科技產業之外能否形成其他具持續性的結構性投資機會，也是該交易台列出的重要問題。上述因素將影響此次戰術性轉多能否延續。

items.title: 美光財報周三登場！ 若利多齊聚 歷史顯示股價能大漲
items.title_en: Micron Earnings Arrive Wednesday! If All Bullish Factors Align, History Shows the Stock Can Soar
paras: 人工智慧(AI)交易寵兒美光(MU-US)將在周三(30日)盤後公布財報，巴隆周刊(Barron’s)報導，要想看到股價重演大幅上漲的歷史，需要看到有利財報的因素到齊。
美光股價周二隨其他晶片股走高，收盤上漲1%至每股1065.08美元
。美光是AI熱潮下的主要受益者之一，過去一年來股價累積大漲近550%。
美光預定公布的財報可能不只影響美光，也可能改變其他多檔股票的市場情緒，關鍵在於財報釋出的訊號，是否能讓投資人看清未來AI支出的走向。
過去幾年，美光財報公布後曾出現相當驚人的漲勢，但也曾大幅下跌，整體而言可說漲跌各半。

11季財報後單日表現 漲跌各半

檢視從2024會計年度算起的11個季度以來，美光在財報公布隔日的股價表現，為五次上漲、六次下跌。其中有幾次的波動幅度相當劇烈：例如2025會計年度第1季財報公布後，美光股價重挫16.2%，但今年6月公布最近一次財報後，股價大漲15.7%，創下史上最佳的財報後單日表現。
從技術面來看，目前美光的股價位置相當有利。周二收盤價高於20日、50日與200日簡單移動平均線，分別為1000美元、945美元與665美元。當股價高於短期移動平均線，且短期均線又高於長期均線時，通常被視為股價動能偏正面的訊號。

分析師看好財報 記憶體價格成關鍵

從基本面來看，分析師也對美光即將公布的財報抱持樂觀態度。儘管市場仍擔心AI需求能否持續，但分析師表示，晶片價格看起來依然強勁，這正是美光業務的重要驅動因素。
Wedbush分析師周一發布報告指出：「晶片價格應會顯著優於美光ˊ最近期財測所假設的水準。」該券商重申美光「優於大盤」評級，目標價為1400美元。
分析師說：「儘管我們將預估值上修至略高於公司先前財測區間的高標，但我們認為記憶體價格走勢顯示，未來仍有進一步調升的空間。」
摩根大通(JPM-US)分析師周一則表示：「預料在持續的價格動能帶動下，美光財報將再次優於預期並上修財測。」
摩根大通給予美光「優於大盤」評級，目標價1540美元。分析師說：「在記憶體市場結構性供應緊俏的背景下，目前基本面仍具建設性，且仍有多項因素可能推動財報優於預期和調升財測。」
paras_en: AI‑driven chip darling Micron (MU‑US) will release its earnings after the market on Wednesday (the 30th). Barron’s reports that to see a repeat of the stock’s historic big jumps, all the favorable earnings factors need to be present.
Micron’s share price rose 1% on Tuesday, keeping pace with other chip stocks, closing at $1,065.08 per share.
Micron is one of the main beneficiaries of the AI boom, having rallied nearly 550% over the past year.
The upcoming earnings could affect not only Micron but also sentiment toward many other stocks; the key is whether the earnings signal lets investors see the future trajectory of AI spending.
In recent years Micron’s post‑earnings moves have been striking—sometimes soaring, sometimes plunging—with overall gains and losses roughly split 50‑50.

Looking at the 11 quarters since the start of fiscal 2024, Micron’s stock moved up on five earnings days and down on six. Some swings were extreme: after FY2025 Q1 results the stock fell 16.2%, while after the most recent June release it jumped 15.7%, the best single‑day post‑earnings gain on record.

Technically, Micron’s price is in a favorable spot. Tuesday’s close was above its 20‑day, 50‑day and 200‑day simple moving averages, which sit at $1,000, $945 and $665 respectively. When the price is above the short‑term averages and those averages are above the long‑term average, it is usually taken as a bullish momentum signal.

Fundamentally, analysts are optimistic about the upcoming earnings. Although the market still worries about the sustainability of AI demand, analysts say chip prices remain strong, which is a key driver for Micron’s business.

Wedbush analysts wrote on Monday that “chip prices are likely to be significantly higher than the levels assumed in Micron’s latest earnings guidance.” The firm reiterated a “outperform” rating on Micron with a target price of $1,400.
One analyst added, “While we are nudging our estimates slightly above the company’s prior guidance range, we believe the trajectory of memory prices still leaves room for further upside.”
JPMorgan (JPM‑US) analysts said on Monday, “Given the continued price momentum, we expect Micron’s earnings to again beat expectations and prompt an upgrade to guidance.”

JPMorgan rates Micron “outperform” with a target price of $1,540, noting that “with structural tightness in memory supply, the fundamentals remain constructive and several factors could drive earnings above expectations and higher guidance.”

items.title: 期中選舉倒數5周！川普宣布啟動32天全美巡迴拉票行程   力保共和黨國會兩院多數
items.title_en: Midterm Election Countdown: 5 Weeks Left! Trump Announces 32-Day Nationwide Campaign Tour to Boost Republican Majorities in Both Chambers
paras: 美國總統川普週二(29日)在白宮外證實，11月3日期中選舉前將展開為期32天全美競選巡迴，親赴多州為共和黨候選人助陣，首站包括本週的德州、俄亥俄州。川普此舉把總統本人與執政表現直接綁上國會兩院控制權保衛戰。
川普啟動全美「拉票」的背景是油價與海外伊朗雙線承壓。《路透社》報導指出，汽油價格持續墊高家庭成本，選民對生活支出不滿；同時白宮今年大量資源投入對伊朗政策與外交安全事務，中東局勢膠著成選戰辯論焦點。
近來，川普公開淡化油價與伊朗帶來的政治壓力，稱共和黨候選人「都希望我去助選」，並否認有同黨人士刻意保持距離。
這波巡迴啟動時間晚於顧問原先規劃。白宮官員透露，因伊朗衝突、聯合國大會及相關安全事務佔據多數時間，催票排程被壓後，直至選前倒數五週才全速推進。
川普受訪時未公布全部行程，僅確認多州接力，目標是用其支持者動員能力鞏固紅州與搖擺州出票人數。
不過，共和黨候選人態度並不完全一致。部分競選團隊歡迎總統站台，盼川普基本盤拉升募款與造勢，部分選區則更強調地方就業、稅務、治安與個人政績，避免被全國化爭議綁架。
根據路透民調，民主黨在若干眾院關鍵選區勢頭不弱，並在參院多個席次形成拉鋸。若高油價與伊朗政策持續發酵，可能影響獨立選民取向。
後續看點在於川普巡迴節奏與候選人策略如何對接：一方面以「總統牌」凝聚保守動員，另一方面避免將地方選情全盤變成對伊朗行動與能源價格的公投。若共和黨保住兩院，川普剩餘任期推動稅務、能源、移民與國防案將會更順，但失去眾院或參院多數，行政部門將面對更強立法牽制與聽證調查壓力。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump confirmed on Tuesday (the 29th) outside the White House that he will launch a 32‑day nationwide campaign tour before the November 3 midterm elections, personally visiting multiple states to support Republican candidates, with the first stops this week in Texas and Ohio. Trump’s move directly ties his own presidency to the fight to defend control of both chambers of Congress.

The backdrop for Trump’s nationwide "vote‑getting" push is pressure from both rising oil prices and the Iran issue abroad. Reuters reported that gasoline prices are continuously raising household costs, fueling voter dissatisfaction with living expenses; at the same time the White House has poured substantial resources this year into Iran policy and diplomatic security matters, making the stalemate in the Middle East a focal point of election debate.

Recently, Trump has publicly downplayed the political pressure from oil prices and Iran, saying Republican candidates "all want me to campaign for them" and denying that any party members are deliberately keeping their distance.

The tour’s start was later than advisors originally planned. White House officials said that the Iran conflict, the United Nations General Assembly and related security issues occupied most of the time, pushing back the voter‑mobilization schedule until the final five weeks before the election, when it was accelerated at full speed.

Trump did not disclose the full itinerary in the interview, only confirming a relay of stops across multiple states, aiming to use his supporter‑mobilization ability to cement vote totals in red states and swing states.

However, Republican candidates are not uniformly aligned. Some campaign teams welcome the president’s appearances, hoping Trump will boost fundraising and rally the base, while other districts emphasize local jobs, taxes, public safety and personal achievements to avoid being hijacked by national controversies.

According to a Reuters poll, Democrats are showing solid momentum in several key House districts and are engaged in tight races for multiple Senate seats. If high oil prices and Iran policy continue to evolve, they could sway independent voters.

The next focus will be how the rhythm of Trump’s tour aligns with candidate strategies: on one hand using the "president brand" to rally conservative voters, on the other avoiding turning every local contest into a referendum on Iran actions and energy prices. If Republicans retain both chambers, Trump’s remaining term could see smoother progress on tax, energy, immigration and defense legislation; losing the House or Senate majority would subject the administration to stronger legislative checks and heightened hearing investigations.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉輝達傳攜手台鏈衝刺玻璃基板 TPK-KY攻漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Nvidia Rumored to Team Up with Taiwan Chain to Accelerate Glass Substrates, TPK‑KY Hits Upper Limit
paras: 外媒傳出輝達正評估在次世代人工智慧晶片封裝導入玻璃基板，激勵相關供應鏈走強，觸控面板廠TPK-KY(3673-TW)已透過面板技術跨入玻璃穿孔技術，積極布局先進半導體封裝領域，今(30)日股價開高走高，一度攻上漲停價75.5元，成交量較前一日放大逾兩倍。
受到AI與高效能運算晶片大型化推動，傳統有機基板面臨熱能催化下的翹曲挑戰，具備高平整度與尺寸穩定性的玻璃基板成為業界新解方。外媒報導指出輝達正與設備廠合作並希望亞洲供應鏈在兩年內完成開發，最快可能於2028年前正式導入封裝製程。
看好先進封裝長線趨勢，TPK運用累積多年的玻璃加工工藝跨足半導體領域，位於中壢的玻璃穿孔試產線已於9月初正式啟動營運。目前公司正攜手一線封測業者展開技術合作，布局範圍涵蓋玻璃穿孔、載板、玻璃基板及中介層等全方位應用架構。
除玻璃技術研發外，公司入主奕力後已逐步強化半導體營收貢獻，第二季奕力占集團營收比重已達25%。海外產能部分，泰國新廠已完成土建工程，預計今年內完成試運轉並於明年初正式投產，持續為中長期營運分散供應鏈風險。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Nvidia is evaluating the use of glass substrates for next‑generation AI chip packaging, boosting related supply chains. Taiwanese touch‑panel maker TPK‑KY (3673‑TW) has leveraged its panel technology to enter glass‑perforation technology and is actively positioning itself in advanced semiconductor packaging. On the 30th, its stock opened higher, surged to the daily limit price of NT$75.5, and traded at more than twice the volume of the previous day.

Driven by AI and the trend toward larger high‑performance computing chips, traditional organic substrates face warping challenges under thermal stress. Glass substrates, offering superior flatness and dimensional stability, are emerging as an industry solution. Reports say Nvidia is cooperating with equipment vendors and hopes the Asian supply chain can complete development within two years, with possible adoption in packaging processes as early as before 2028.

Seeing the long‑term trend in advanced packaging, TPK is applying its years of glass‑processing expertise to the semiconductor field. Its glass‑perforation pilot line in Zhongli began operations in early September. The company is now partnering with leading front‑line test‑and‑assembly firms, covering a full suite of applications including glass perforation, interposers, glass substrates and intermediate layers.

Beyond glass R&D, the company has strengthened its semiconductor revenue after acquiring Yi‑Li. In Q2, Yi‑Li accounted for 25% of the group’s revenue. On the overseas side, a new plant in Thailand has completed civil works; it is expected to start trial runs later this year and commence full production in early next year, further diversifying supply‑chain risk for mid‑ to long‑term operations.

items.title: 金像電(2368) 亞馬遜入股、營收連創高，股價卻卡關？揭開三大評價瓶頸
items.title_en: Jinxiang Electronics (2368) Amazon Investment, Record Revenue, Yet Stock Stalls? Uncovering Three Valuation Bottlenecks
paras:
股價卡關的原因：利多反應完畢，市場靜待實績
金像電(2368-TW)昨(29 )日公告私募現增案，亞馬遜(Amazon)首度參與認購，且近期營運表現亮眼，2026年前8月累計營收達640.59億元，年增71.25%，7、8月更連續兩月衝破百億元大關，AI相關營收佔比也從先前的20%，一路攀升至40%~50%。
然而，股價衝上高點後，近期卻卡在1,000元至1,140元區間震盪。
根據《優分析產業資料庫》分析，股價缺乏推升動能的主因在於「利多已提前反映」。股價不動，是因為AI佔比、資本支出大增這些利多早已反映，加上亞馬遜以每股856元、認購1,856張(約佔股權0.36%)，雖創下CSP直接入股PCB廠的首例，但規模相對偏小，背書意義大於實質資金挹注，市場要的是訂單放量，不是股權比例，無法單憑此消息驅動評價重估。

法人上修門檻：重點非題材，而是HDI混壓良率與毛利率表現
市場最為關注的核心疑慮，來自於四大CSP客戶在下一代ASIC平台(如Trainium 4、TPU V9)，未來設計會由傳統高層次板(HLC)轉向「HDI＋HLC混壓」。混壓技術需經過多次壓合，高階壓合製程若控管不當，易引發通孔龜裂與爆板問題。雖然公司強調3至4階HDI混壓挑戰不大，但初期學習曲線仍會對良率形成考驗。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)
若要啟動新一輪獲利上修，觸發點並非依靠訂單題材，而是必須看到三大指標實際落地：
ASIC混壓良率驗證：混壓初期良率低，若混壓順利則有機會提高毛利率。
毛利率逐季走高：2026年第二季毛利率34.65%略低於預期，主因材料轉嫁時差與費用增加，第三季需如期回升並維持連續高毛利。
海外產能放量：泰國廠月產值自第二季約6億元，第三季目標躍升至13億元，並加速轉向高單價AI板生產。

資本支出翻倍，折舊壓力疊加
在擴產佈局方面，金像電將2026年資本支出由170億元上修至190億元，2027至2028年更預計提高至200億元，規劃於2027至2029年間每年新建一座新廠(含蘇州與泰國二廠)。雖然台灣產能2026下半年已年增50%，且供不應求讓產品單價獲得支撐，但龐大的固定資產折舊費用大幅提升，將在短期內壓抑毛利率衝高空間。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)

投資人後續觀察重點：第四季財報與良率雜音消弭
綜合《優分析產業資料庫》整體評估，金像電長線受惠AI與伺服器高層板需求的趨勢未變，訂單能見度已延伸至2027年。投資人接下來應緊盯，第四季新ASIC專案出貨後的實際毛利率，只要良率雜音消弭，且折舊影響低於預期，評價區間才有大幅向上打開的機會。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)

paras_en: The reason the stock is stuck: positive news already priced in, market waiting for results. Jinxiang Electronics (2368‑TW) announced on the 29th a private placement increase, with Amazon participating in the subscription for the first time. Recent operations are impressive, with cumulative revenue of NT$64.059 billion for the first eight months of 2026, up 71.25% year‑over‑year, and July‑August both breaking the NT$10 billion mark. AI‑related revenue grew from about 20% to roughly 40‑50% of total.
However, after soaring to a high, the stock has recently been confined to a range of NT$1,000‑1,140.

According to the Yōu Analysis Industry Database, the main reason the price lacks upward momentum is that “the good news has already been reflected.” The price is flat because the AI share, the surge in capital expenditures and other positives are already priced in. Amazon’s subscription at NT$856 per share for 1,856 lots (about 0.36% of equity) is the first direct CSP stake in a PCB maker, but the scale is relatively small; the endorsement matters more than the actual cash infusion. The market wants order volume, not equity percentage, so this news alone cannot drive a valuation re‑rating.

Institutional upgrade threshold: the focus is not the theme but HDI mixed‑layer yield and gross margin performance. The core concern for the market is that the four major CSP customers will shift next‑generation ASIC platforms (e.g., Trainium 4, TPU V9) from traditional high‑level boards (HLC) to “HDI + HLC mixed‑layer.” Mixed‑layer technology requires multiple lamination steps, and if high‑level lamination is not well controlled, it can cause via cracking and board breakage. Although the company says 3‑ to 4‑stage HDI mixed‑layer poses little challenge, the early learning curve will still test yields.
(Source: Yōu Analysis Industry Database)
To trigger a new round of profit upgrades, the catalyst is not order themes but the actual implementation of three key indicators:
ASIC mixed‑layer yield verification: early mixed‑layer yields are low; if the process runs smoothly, gross margins can improve.
Quarterly gross margin rise: Q2 2026 gross margin of 34.65% was slightly below expectations due to material timing shifts and higher costs; Q3 must rebound as scheduled and sustain high margins.
Overseas capacity expansion: the Thailand plant’s monthly output was about NT$6 billion in Q2 and aims to jump to NT$13 billion in Q3, accelerating the shift to high‑price AI boards.

Capital expenditures double, depreciation pressure adds up. In its expansion plan, Jinxiang raises 2026 capex from NT$170 billion to NT$190 billion, and projects NT$200 billion for 2027‑2028, planning to build a new factory each year from 2027‑2029 (including a second plant in Suzhou and Thailand). Although Taiwan capacity grows 50% YoY in the second half of 2026 and tight supply supports product pricing, the massive fixed‑asset depreciation will sharply curb short‑term margin expansion.
(Source: Yōu Analysis Industry Database)

Investor watch points: Q4 earnings and yield noise elimination. Overall assessment from the Yōu Analysis Industry Database says Jinxiang’s long‑term benefit from AI and high‑level server board demand remains unchanged, with order visibility extending to 2027. Investors should closely monitor the actual gross margin after Q4 new ASIC project shipments; if yield noise disappears and depreciation impact is lower than expected, the valuation range could open significantly upward.
(Source: Yōu Analysis Industry Database)

items.title: 〈焦點股〉受惠星鏈衛星題材、光通訊產品量產 穩懋衝上漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Benefiting from Starlink Satellite Theme and Mass Production of Optical Communication Products, Wenmao Hits Upper Limit
paras: 砷化鎵三五大廠穩懋(3105-TW)受惠於SpaceX(SPCX-US)最大型火箭「星艦」於本(9)月28日從美國德州發射場起飛，首度成功進入地球軌道，加上第3季起高階手機拉貨強勁，今(30)日開高走高，盤中在大單敲進下，亮燈攻上漲停價542元，成交量爆增至4萬張以上，股價不僅站上所有均線，也創近3個月來波段新高。
外電指出，SpaceX至今已完成部署26顆迄今最先進的星鏈衛星，未來單次發射成本有望大幅降低，也意味SpaceX未來能以極快速度完成全球高頻寬、低延遲的衛星網路布署。
穩懋除了在第3季起受惠美系高階手機新品拉貨外，AI資料中心帶動1.6T高速光通訊產品放量，加上低軌衛星需求升溫，光通訊及基礎設施業務逐步成為新成長引擎，產品組合也有助於改善後續獲利表現。
法人表示，穩懋衛星相關產品預計在下半年接續放量，產品結構由手機射頻元件延伸到光通訊與航太通訊元件。
外資則表示，穩懋在第3季營收預估將維持低雙位數季增，主要受惠光通訊及基礎建設需求升溫，WiFi業務也因路由器需求回暖，展望由持平上修至季增，公司同時看好航太及非手機光通訊市場後續成長。
穩懋近年除了手機PA產品業務，持續布局光通訊、航太與高階傳輸應用，切入低軌衛星新世代應用，布局衛星間串接功率放大器，延伸至衛星對地面接收站元件，產品自傳統的頻段延伸到E、V頻段，今(2026)年更將推出頻率可達75GHz至110GHz的W頻段功率放大器(PA)，目前也已出貨。
paras_en: GaN (gallium nitride) major manufacturers Wenmao (3105-TW) benefited from SpaceX (SPCX-US) largest rocket "Starship" launching on September 28 from Texas, achieving its first successful entry into Earth orbit. Coupled with strong demand from high‑end smartphones starting in Q3, the stock opened higher on the 30th and, amid large buy orders, surged to the daily limit price of NT$542, with volume exploding to over 40,000 shares. The price not only stayed above all moving averages but also set a new three‑month high for the swing.

Foreign media reported that SpaceX has so far deployed 26 of the most advanced Starlink satellites, and future single‑launch costs are expected to drop dramatically, meaning SpaceX could rapidly roll out a global high‑bandwidth, low‑latency satellite network.

Beyond the Q3 boost from U.S. high‑end smartphone shipments, Wenmao’s AI data‑center business is driving volume for its 1.6‑terabit high‑speed optical communication products. Rising demand for low‑earth‑orbit satellites is turning optical communications and infrastructure into new growth engines, and the product mix should help improve future profitability.

Institutional investors said Wenmao’s satellite‑related products are expected to continue scaling in the second half of the year, expanding the product portfolio from mobile RF components to optical and aerospace communication components.

Foreign investors noted that Wenmao’s Q3 revenue is forecast to maintain low‑double‑digit sequential growth, mainly due to hotter demand for optical communications and infrastructure, with Wi‑Fi business also rebounding as router demand warms. Outlook has been upgraded from flat to sequential growth, and the company remains optimistic about aerospace and non‑mobile optical communication markets.

In recent years, besides its mobile PA product line, Wenmao has been expanding into optical communications, aerospace and high‑end transmission applications, entering the new generation of low‑orbit satellite uses. It is developing inter‑satellite power amplifiers and extending to ground‑station components, broadening frequency coverage from traditional bands to E and V bands. In 2026 it will launch W‑band (75‑110 GHz) power amplifiers, which are already in shipment.

items.title: 散熱股只有健策(3653)被大幅上修！2027年EPS衝208.86元、上修近今年3倍，法人看見了什麼獲利跳升關鍵？
items.title_en: Only Heat‑Sink Stock Jian‑Ce (3653) Gets a Big Upgrade! 2027 EPS Jumps to NT$208.86, Nearly Triple This Year’s Forecast – What Profit‑Boosting Factors Did Analysts Spot?
paras: 2026年09月30日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 根據優分析產業資料庫觀察，昨(29)日共有兩家法人上修健策(3653-TW)2027年EPS預估，最高上看208.86元，顯示市場正重新評估新一代AI晶片散熱規格升級帶來的獲利空間。

其中一家法人2027年 EPS由149.49元大幅調升至208.86元，增幅達39.7%；2026年EPS則由66.46元提高至71.65元，增幅約7.8%，上修幅度明顯集中在2027年。另一家外資也將2027年EPS由156.4元調高至176.13元，增幅12.6%；2028年EPS則由236.22元提高至273.21元，增幅15.7%，相較之下，2026年EPS僅由68.24元微幅上調至69.14元。
兩家法人對健策(3653-TW)獲利規模的預估雖有差異，但上修幅度都是集中在2027年以後，反映市場關注的已經不只是AI伺服器出貨成長，還包括新一代TR Lid可能導入後，帶來的產品單價、毛利率及單機價值量提升。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)

TR Lid可能提前導入，產品單價估為現行版本數倍
TR Lid是可拆卸式散熱蓋，採用Ring與Lid分離設計，並增加個別熱壓製程。伺服器組裝時可先移除Lid，再將散熱介面材料及冷板直接配置於晶片上方，藉此減少多層材料造成的熱傳導損耗。
目前市場基準預期，Rubin R200仍採一片式設計，可拆卸式上蓋則由Rubin Ultra開始放量。不過，最新法人認為，新設計有機會提前至Rubin平台導入，相關產品可能在2026年第四季至2027年第一季提前進入少量出貨及封裝測試，若測試、良率與平台設計順利定案，最快可於2027年第二季隨Rubin Ultra放量。
可拆卸式上蓋的ASP估計可達現行一片式產品的5至6倍，若後續ASIC客戶跟進採用，價值量提升幅度可能更大。因此，健策(3653-TW)2027年的獲利成長除了取決於伺服器出貨量，更要觀察TR Lid的驗證結果、導入平台及實際滲透率，只要新規格滲透率提高，仍可能明顯放大健策的單機價值量。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)

獲利能否跳升，先看2027年第一季前的測試結果
根據優分析產業資料庫，法人平均預估健策(3653-TW)第三季營收95.82億元，公司7月及8月營收合計為64.39億元，已完成法人第三季營收預估的 67.2%。若要達到預估，9月營收約需逾31億元。換句話說，法人第三季預估與目前營運軌跡大致相符，後續仍須觀察9月營收能否符合，甚至優於市場預期。
因此，這次法人上修的重點不在2026年的小幅調整，而是提前反映2027年的產品規格升級。後續應觀察TR Lid於2026年第四季至2027年第一季的封裝測試結果、相關產線能否在2027年年中如期建置完成，以及Rubin系列平台的設計定案、實際採用率與量產速度。

paras_en: September 30, 2026 (U‑Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – According to the U‑Analysis industry database, two institutional investors on September 29 raised their 2027 EPS forecasts for Jian‑Ce (3653‑TW), with the highest estimate reaching NT$208.86, indicating the market is re‑evaluating profit potential from next‑generation AI‑chip cooling spec upgrades.

One institution lifted its 2027 EPS from NT$149.49 to NT$208.86, a 39.7% increase; its 2026 EPS rose from NT$66.46 to NT$71.65, about 7.8%, with the bulk of the upgrade focused on 2027. Another foreign investor raised its 2027 EPS from NT$156.4 to NT$176.13 (12.6% up) and its 2028 EPS from NT$236.22 to NT$273.21 (15.7% up), while its 2026 EPS was only nudged from NT$68.24 to NT$69.14.

Although the two institutions differ in the scale of Jian‑Ce’s profit outlook, both concentrate the upgrades on post‑2027, reflecting market focus not only on AI‑server shipment growth but also on the potential price, margin and unit‑value uplift from the upcoming generation of TR Lid integration.
(Image source: U‑Analysis industry database)

TR Lid could be introduced early, with unit prices estimated at several times the current version. The TR Lid is a detachable cooling cover that separates the ring and lid and adds individual hot‑press processes. During server assembly, the lid can be removed first, allowing thermal interface material and cold plates to be placed directly on the chip, reducing thermal loss caused by multiple material layers.

Current market expectations assume the Rubin R200 will retain a monolithic design, while detachable covers will start scaling with Rubin Ultra. However, the latest institutional view sees the new design possibly being introduced on the Rubin platform ahead of schedule, with limited shipments and package testing as early as Q4 2026 to Q1 2027. If testing, yields and platform design are confirmed, volume production could begin as early as Q2 2027 with Rubin Ultra.

The ASP of the detachable cover is estimated at 5‑6 times that of the current monolithic product; if ASIC customers adopt it, the value uplift could be even larger. Thus, Jian‑Ce’s 2027 profit growth depends not only on server shipment volume but also on TR Lid validation results, platform adoption and actual penetration. Higher spec penetration could markedly amplify the unit value of Jian‑Ce’s products.
(Image source: U‑Analysis industry database)

Whether profit can leap hinges on test results before Q1 2027. According to the U‑Analysis database, institutions average a Q3 revenue forecast of NT$9.582 billion for Jian‑Ce, with July‑August revenue already at NT$6.439 billion, achieving 67.2% of the Q3 estimate. To hit the forecast, September revenue needs to exceed NT$3.1 billion. In other words, the Q3 outlook aligns with current performance, but September results must still meet or surpass expectations.

Therefore, the focus of this institutional upgrade is not the modest 2026 tweak but an early reflection of the 2027 product spec upgrade. Future monitoring should track TR Lid packaging test outcomes in Q4 2026‑Q1 2027, whether related production lines are completed by mid‑2027 as planned, and the Rubin series platform design finalization, adoption rate and mass‑production speed.

items.title: 今年首家石英元件廠籌資案完成 安碁科技完成3億元面額CB募集
items.title_en: This Year's First Quartz Component Manufacturer Financing Deal Completed; Anqing Technology Completes NT$300 Million Face-Value Convertible Bond Offering
paras: 安碁科技(6174-TW))今(30)日宣布完成3億元面額的無擔保可轉換公債(CB)完成募集，籌款3.06億元，爲今年首家石英元件廠籌資案完成 ，安碁科技的這筆無擔保可轉換公債，預計在10月2日上櫃掛牌交易。
安碁科技的這3億元面額的筆無擔保可轉換公債以102元發行，合計籌款爲3.06億元，轉換價爲46.4元，轉換溢價率爲105.22%。
擴充營運能量中的安碁科技2026年1-6月營收3.64億元，稅後純益3854萬元，年增3.72倍，每股純益0.77元。
安碁科技預計10月7日召開法人說明會。
paras_en: Anqing Technology (6174‑TW) announced today (the 30th) that it has completed the fundraising of an unsecured convertible bond (CB) with a face value of NT$300 million, raising a total of NT$306 million, making it the first financing deal of a quartz component manufacturer this year. The bond is expected to be listed on the over‑the‑counter market on October 2.

The NT$300 million face‑value unsecured convertible bond was issued at NT$102 per bond, resulting in total proceeds of NT$306 million, with a conversion price of NT$46.4 and a conversion premium of 105.22%.

In its operational expansion, Anqing Technology reported revenue of NT$364 million and net profit after tax of NT$38.54 million for the January‑June 2026 period, a year‑over‑year increase of 3.72 times, and earnings per share of NT$0.77.
Anqing Technology plans to hold a corporate briefing for institutional investors on October 7.

items.title: 封測股昨日重挫、今日全面反攻！京元電子(2449)、南茂(8150)、矽格(6257)誰的2027年成長最強？
paras: 2026年09月30日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 封測股昨日遭遇獲利調節，京元電子(2449-TW)、南茂(8150-TW)、矽格(6257-TW)同步走弱，今日卻快速反攻，顯示市場對AI晶片、記憶體及高階測試需求仍有期待。
不過，同樣是封測股且受惠AI與高階測試，京元電(2449)、矽格(6257)及南茂(8150)在2027年的成長速度可能明顯不同。
優分析資料庫預估，京元電2027年營收年增49.7%、EPS年增約66%，成長幅度居三家公司之首；矽格營收年增約20.7%排名第二；南茂則約18.6%。
造成差距的關鍵，不只是誰投入最多資本支出，而是新產品的放量時點。京元電的Rubin與ASIC測試在2027年進入完整貢獻期，矽格的新廠及矽光子逐步量產，南茂的矽光子業務則要到2028年才可能明顯放大。

京元電最強：2027年迎接Rubin完整貢獻
京元電2026年AI相關營收占比已達約七成，但真正的成長高峰可能落在2027年。
原本備受期待的Rubin晶片，因散熱設計調整，首批測試時間延後至2026年第三季底，第四季才開始正式放量。換句話說，2026年只有部分營收貢獻，2027年才是Rubin完整出貨一整年的首個年度。
除了Rubin，京元電還有Google TPU、CPU、ASIC及台積電CP測試委外等多項動能。其中，Google TPU與CPU測試訂單在2026年預估已占營收約一成，後續若雲端服務商持續擴大自研晶片，測試需求還有進一步增加空間。
優分析產業資料庫預估，京元電2027年營收可達718.20億元、年增49.7%；EPS上看14.71元，年增約66%，獲利增速高於營收。
這代表隨著高階測試產能利用率提升，京元電除了營收增加，也有機會透過產品組合改善與營運槓桿，放大獲利成長。

矽格居次：新廠量產加上矽光子接棒
矽格2027年的成長動能，主要來自新產能開出與矽光子客戶進入量產。
湖口二廠已於2026年7月量產，中興三廠預計2027年第一季加入營運，兩座新廠合計可提高約30%至40%的產能，支撐AI伺服器、ASIC、網通及高速傳輸晶片的測試需求。
矽格也積極布局矽光子封裝測試。多數客戶預計在2027年進入量產階段，但初期營收規模仍須觀察實際驗證與拉貨進度，因此2027年比較像是矽光子由驗證走向量產的起點，而不是獲利全面爆發的一年。
優分析產業資料庫預估，矽格2027年營收為287.97億元、年增20.7%，EPS約12.66元。法人較樂觀的估計，營收年增幅則可能接近28%。
矽格的優勢在於產品線較分散，除了矽光子，還涵蓋AI手機、ASIC、伺服器與網通晶片；風險則是新廠投產後折舊先行，若客戶量產速度低於預期，毛利率改善可能延後。

南茂第三：記憶體仍是主力，矽光子要等2028年
南茂2027年的成長主力仍是記憶體，而不是矽光子。
隨著DRAM及NAND需求改善、價格走升，記憶體廠提高產能利用率，將同步帶動後段封裝測試需求。相較於京元電直接受惠高階AI晶片，南茂的成長更接近記憶體景氣復甦帶來的循環反轉。
南茂目前也在進行矽光子及光學凸塊客戶驗證，但依管理層規劃，2027年主要是客戶活動與驗證案增加，較顯著的營收貢獻可能要等到2028年。
因此，南茂2027年仍屬於新舊動能交接的過渡期。優分析產業資料庫預估，南茂2027年營收為360.87億元、年增18.6%，EPS約6.50元；法人預估營收增幅則約16%。
南茂的成長幅度雖低於京元電與矽格，但若記憶體價格及稼動率持續上升，仍可能透過較低基期帶來獲利彈性。

三家2027年成長比較

誰的2027年最強？
若單看營收與獲利成長速度，京元電明顯勝出。
京元電不只2027年營收年增率接近五成，EPS增幅更超過六成，顯示Rubin、ASIC及CP測試委外放量後，新增營收有機會轉化為更高的獲利。
矽格排名第二，成長動能來自新廠、AI與矽光子，但仍須等待客戶量產及新產能利用率提升；南茂則以記憶體復甦為主，矽光子要到2028年才可能成為較明顯的新引擎。
不過，京元電的高成長預估也建立在Rubin如期放量、ASIC訂單沒有轉移的前提下。若散熱設計再次延後，或日月光等競爭對手分食測試訂單，2027年成長率仍可能遭到下修。
封測股2027年都有成長，但真正的差別在放量時點：京元電已準備進入收成期，矽格正從擴產走向量產，南茂則仍在等待下一個新業務接棒。

items.title: 大甲(2221)9天股價翻倍！8月EPS暴增近2.5倍，半導體廠務小廠憑什麼被重估？
items.title_en: DaJia (2221) Doubles Stock in 9 Days! August EPS Surges Nearly 2.5‑Fold, Why Is This Small Semiconductor‑Facility Supplier Being Re‑valued?
paras: 2026年09月30日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 大甲(2221-TWO)近期股價強勢，市場看到的是8月營收年增81.31%，但《優分析產業資料庫》的小助理發現，真正值得注意的不是營收變多，而是公司的獲利來源正在改變。
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)
過去大甲主要供應石化廠使用的不鏽鋼管配件，如今成長重心已轉向數據中心冷卻系統管配件，占比攀升至約六成，接單能見度更看到2028年。產品組合轉向高毛利業務，也帶動毛利率與營業利益率同步上升。
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)

從石化建廠，轉向AI與晶圓廠資本支出
大甲過去的主要客戶包括台塑、中油及長春石化，營運表現高度依賴石化產業的建廠需求。
但近年國內缺乏大型石化投資案，中國產能過剩又造成價格競爭，傳統化工級管件成長受限。大甲因此把潔淨級管件的精密加工、電解拋光及潔淨檢測能力，延伸至數據中心冷卻系統、晶圓代工與封測廠的建廠需求。
這代表大甲的營運循環，正從「石化景氣」轉向「AI資料中心與台積電資本支出」，是成長結構的質變。

不只賣管材：大甲如何切入台積電廠務系統？
大甲現在已不只是供應不鏽鋼管材，而是透過旗下子公司大川研科技，進一步切入半導體廠的特殊氣體與化學品供應系統。
半導體製程會使用大量特殊氣體與化學品，管路必須具備極高潔淨度、耐腐蝕性及氣密性。任何微量雜質或洩漏，都可能影響晶圓良率，因此相關零組件需要經過電解拋光、潔淨清洗、精密焊接及多項測試，技術門檻高於一般工業管件。
大甲提供的不只是潔淨級管材與閥件，也涵蓋特殊氣體供應系統建置、管路施工、品質檢測及設備維護。
其中，大川研科技長期承攬晶圓廠的廠務工程與特殊氣體系統服務，並在竹科、中科及南科等廠區提供氣體系統管理與設備維護。隨著台積電持續擴充先進製程與先進封裝產能，大甲也從上游管材供應商，逐步成為半導體建廠供應鏈的一環。

高毛利產品放量，獲利增幅開始超越營收
2026年前7月，大甲營收年增21.73%；8月營收進一步年增81.31%，顯示相關工程訂單加速出貨。
更重要的是，產品組合改善已反映在獲利能力。2026年第二季毛利率升至23.84%，營業利益率達14.57%，分別高於2025全年的20.24%與10.01%，單季EPS則達1.17元。
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)
優分析 AI Insight 顯示，高毛利的數據中心冷卻管件占比提升，是大甲毛利率走高的重要原因。公司不再只是靠增加出貨量成長，而是開始賣出附加價值更高的產品。

接單看到2028年，仍有兩項風險
大甲的冷卻管件接單能見度已延伸至2028年，但這條成長曲線仍有兩項變數。
首先是客戶集中度。最大客戶銷售占比已由2024年的22.83%，提高至2025年的26.60%，代表營運愈來愈依賴少數晶圓廠與大型客戶。一旦客戶擴廠進度放慢，大甲受到的影響也會更加直接。
其次是中國低價競爭。安徽大甲2025年營收年減84.51%，並出現虧損，反映中國市場需求疲弱與價格壓力。目前競爭主要集中在化工級產品，但若未來延伸至冷卻管件，大甲的高毛利也可能受到挑戰。

後市關鍵：占比六成能否繼續提高？
大甲近期的改變，不只是搭上AI或台積電擴廠題材，而是營收與獲利結構同時換軌。
接下來應觀察數據中心冷卻管件占比能否維持六成以上、毛利率能否守住23%，以及接單能見度是否真的轉化為營收。
如果高毛利冷卻管件持續放量，大甲可能不再只是一家傳統管件廠；但在股價快速上漲後，客戶集中與中國價格戰，也將成為檢驗這場轉型能否延續的關鍵。

paras_en: September 30, 2026 (U‑Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – DaJia (2221‑TWO) has seen a strong recent stock rally. The market notes an 81.31% year‑over‑year increase in August revenue, but the assistant in the U‑Analysis industry database points out that the real story is a shift in the company’s profit sources, not just higher sales.
Image source: U‑Analysis industry database

Historically DaJia supplied stainless‑steel pipe fittings for petrochemical plants; now its growth focus has moved to data‑center cooling system pipe components, which now account for about 60% of its business and have order visibility out to 2028. The shift toward higher‑margin products has lifted both gross margin and operating margin.
Image source: U‑Analysis industry database

From petrochemical plant construction to AI and wafer‑fab capital spending
DaJia’s past major customers included Formosa Plastics, CPC and Chang Chun Petrochemical, making its performance highly dependent on petrochemical plant demand.

But in recent years domestic large‑scale petrochemical projects have been scarce, and overcapacity in China has driven price competition, limiting growth for traditional chemical‑grade pipe fittings. DaJia therefore extended its clean‑grade pipe precision machining, electropolishing and clean‑room testing capabilities to serve data‑center cooling systems, wafer‑foundry and test‑assembly plant construction needs.
This means DaJia’s operating cycle is shifting from a “petrochemical cycle” to “AI data‑centers and TSMC capital spending,” a qualitative change in its growth structure.

More Than Pipe Sales: How DaJia Is Entering TSMC’s Facility System
DaJia now supplies not only stainless‑steel pipe but, through its subsidiary DaChuan Research Technology, also taps into the semiconductor plant’s special gas and chemical supply systems.

Semiconductor processes use large volumes of specialty gases and chemicals, requiring piping with extremely high cleanliness, corrosion resistance and leak‑tightness. Any trace impurity or leak can affect wafer yield, so related components must undergo electropolishing, clean‑room washing, precision welding and multiple tests, raising the technical barrier above ordinary industrial pipe.
DaJia provides not only clean‑grade pipe and valves but also special‑gas system construction, pipe installation, quality testing and equipment maintenance.

DaChuan Research Technology has long handled facility engineering and specialty‑gas system services for wafer fabs, offering gas‑system management and equipment upkeep at Hsinchu, Central and Southern Taiwan science parks. As TSMC continues to expand advanced process and advanced packaging capacity, DaJia is evolving from an upstream pipe supplier to an integral part of the semiconductor construction supply chain.

High‑Margin Products Scale Up, Profit Growth Outpaces Revenue
In the first seven months of 2026, DaJia’s revenue grew 21.73% year‑over‑year; August revenue jumped another 81.31% year‑over‑year, indicating accelerated shipment of related engineering orders.

More importantly, the improved product mix is already reflected in profitability. In Q2 2026, gross margin rose to 23.84% and operating margin to 14.57%, both above the full‑year 2025 figures of 20.24% and 10.01% respectively, and quarterly EPS reached NT$1.17.
Image source: U‑Analysis industry database

U‑Analysis AI Insight shows that the rising share of high‑margin data‑center cooling pipe components is a key driver of DaJia’s higher gross margin. The company is no longer growing merely by shipping more volume; it is now selling higher‑value‑added products.
Order visibility extends to 2028, but two risks remain

First, customer concentration. The share of sales to the largest customer rose from 22.83% in 2024 to 26.60% in 2025, indicating growing reliance on a few wafer fabs and large clients. A slowdown in those customers’ expansion would hit DaJia more directly.

Second, low‑price competition from China. Anhui DaJia’s 2025 revenue fell 84.51% year‑over‑year and turned loss-making, reflecting weak demand and price pressure in the Chinese market. Competition now focuses on chemical‑grade products, but if it spreads to cooling pipe components, DaJia’s high margins could be challenged.

Future key: Can the 60% share continue to rise?
DaJia’s recent changes are not just riding the AI or TSMC expansion themes; both revenue and profit structures are shifting simultaneously.
Going forward, watch whether data‑center cooling pipe components can stay above a 60% share, whether gross margin can hold at 23%, and whether order visibility truly translates into revenue.

If high‑margin cooling pipes keep scaling, DaJia may no longer be just a traditional pipe maker; however, after the rapid stock rise, customer concentration and Chinese price wars will be the litmus test for the sustainability of this transformation.

items.title: 幫你下單！Robinhood祭出AI交易代理 週末美股24小時交易明年登場
items.title_en: Help You Place Orders! Robinhood Rolls Out AI Trading Agents, 24‑Hour Weekend US Stock Trading to Launch Next Year
paras: Robinhood Markets (HOOD-US) 正大幅擴充面向活躍交易者的產品與交易工具，宣布將把AI代理(AI Agent)直接整合進交易App，讓用戶透過人工智慧分析市場、建立交易策略及執行交易，同時規劃開放部分美股及ETF週末24小時交易，進一步將交易時間延伸至全年全天候。
Robinhood在休士頓舉行的HOOD Summit 2026宣布推出Robinhood Agents，將原本需要具備技術能力、透過第三方AI工具連接Robinhood交易帳戶的功能，改為直接內建於App。用戶可建立專屬AI代理、選擇AI模型，透過對話方式要求Agent研究市場、分析投資組合、建立策略並執行交易。
Robinhood表示，5月推出的Agentic Trading截至目前已有超過15萬名客戶開設Agentic Trading帳戶，AI代理每天使用Robinhood工具的次數接近3000萬次。新推出的Robinhood Agents則將這項能力進一步普及，讓不熟悉AI技術的用戶也能在App內建立及使用AI代理。
新系統將使用獨立的Agentic Trading帳戶，AI代理只能存取用戶配置在該帳戶中的資金。用戶可以選擇是否要求人工核准每筆交易，預設設定為開啟人工核准。此外，Robinhood即將推出名為Loops的功能，允許用戶將交易策略設定為持續執行的指令，例如每天檢查市場並在符合條件時自動下單，甚至在用戶睡眠期間持續執行交易。

Robinhood同時推出AI代理Apps，讓AI代理可以取得更多專業市場數據及分析工具。首批及後續加入的11家數據與工具業者包括Unusual Whales、Nasdaq (NDAQ-US)、SpotGamma、Wendy、Quiver Quantitative、Token Terminal、Visual Crossing、SkyFi、Narravance，以及即將加入的Carbon Arc和Fiscal.ai。部分工具月費介於5美元至30美元不等，所有AI代理Apps均提供1個月免費試用。
Robinhood也宣布將擴大交易時間，計畫在明年初開放部分美股及ETF週末24小時交易，但仍須等待監管審查。週末交易將從精選股票及ETF開始，並適用於各類帳戶，交易基礎設施則由另類交易系統Bruce ATS提供。
這項計畫將延伸Robinhood在2023年推出的24 Hour Market。目前用戶可在美東時間週日晚間8時至週五晚間8時交易數百檔股票及ETF。Reuters指出，Robinhood在推出全天候平日交易功能約10個月後曾表示，在交易最活躍的日子，非傳統交易時段的成交量占每日總交易量最高達25%。此次週末交易則是Robinhood首次把交易服務延伸至週末。
Robinhood表示，週末交易初期將採精選標的模式，待監管審查完成後推出。市場也存在非傳統交易時段流動性較低、價差擴大及價格不確定性提高等問題，因此週末交易的實際涵蓋標的與上線時間仍取決於監管進度。
除了AI及交易時間，Robinhood還宣布推出加密貨幣永續期貨。符合資格的美國客戶未來幾個月可直接透過App交易BTC、ETH、SOL、XRP、DOGE、ADA、LINK及HYPE永續期貨。這些合約沒有到期日，BTC及ETH永續期貨最高可使用10倍槓桿，其餘標的最高為3倍。
相關永續期貨由Robinhood Derivatives透過Bitstamp提供。Robinhood表示，在今年年底前每筆交易收取1個基點(0.01%)費用，並提供停損、止盈、即時清算價格及風險警示等功能。
Robinhood也將擴大預測市場產品，推出與企業財報相關的Earnings Contracts。這類合約將透過Cboe提供，讓符合資格且取得選擇權交易權限的用戶，針對企業特定財務或營運指標進行交易，例如企業是否超越財報預期、營收是否達到特定目標或是否跨越特定財務門檻。
與傳統股票交易不同，這類二元KPI選擇權的結算依據並非公司股價，而是企業向美國證券交易委員會提交的財報中所揭露的特定財務或營運指標。每份合約最高支付1美元，Robinhood及Cboe均表示今年年底前暫不收取合約相關費用，但產品仍須接受監管審查。
在其他交易功能方面，Robinhood將從10月起延長熱門標的的選擇權交易時間，交易時段將從上午7時30分延長至下午4時15分，官方估計整體交易時間增加35%。公司也將在10月推出股票OCO(One-Cancels-the-Other)訂單，讓用戶同時設定止盈及停損價格，其中一筆訂單成交後，另一筆將自動取消，選擇權版本預計明年初推出。
此外，Robinhood預計下月將讓符合資格的保證金客戶選擇啟用最高4倍的盤中購買力，較目前最高2倍提高。公司也設置收盤前推播通知及首次啟用時的App提醒。
Robinhood Social也將從今年稍早的測試階段擴大至所有符合資格的美國客戶。新功能包括分享加密貨幣及股票圖表、投資組合配置與損益，並預計配合第三季財報季推出即時財報功能，讓用戶觀看財報電話會議並在過程中進行交易。
Robinhood此次大幅擴充產品，反映其持續將服務重心延伸至活躍交易者。公司希望透過AI代理、全天候交易、永續期貨、財報合約及更多專業數據工具，把過去較常見於對沖基金、量化交易機構及大型金融機構的交易工具整合到零售投資平台。
不過，Robinhood也在產品揭露中強調，AI代理可能誤解指令、使用不完整或過時資訊，或以用戶未預期的方式執行交易。若用戶關閉人工核准功能，AI代理可在沒有逐筆確認的情況下自行下單；Loops啟動後也可能在用戶未操作App甚至睡眠期間自動建立、修改或取消交易，因此相關交易損益及自動化規則仍由用戶自行承擔責任。
Robinhood同時指出，延長交易時段可能面臨較低流動性、更高波動率、更大買賣價差及價格不確定性等風險，而AI交易亦涉及第三方大型語言模型的資料政策及監管、隱私與資安問題。週末股票交易目前仍等待監管審查，AI代理及其他新產品的實際推出時間與適用客戶範圍也可能因監管及技術因素調整。
paras_en: Robinhood Markets (HOOD-US) is dramatically expanding products and tools for active traders, announcing that AI Agents will be integrated directly into its trading app, allowing users to leverage artificial intelligence to analyze markets, build trading strategies and execute trades, while also planning to open weekend 24‑hour trading for select US stocks and ETFs next year, extending trading to all‑day, all‑year availability.

At the HOOD Summit 2026 in Houston, Robinhood unveiled Robinhood Agents, moving the capability that previously required technical skill and third‑party AI tools to connect to a Robinhood account into a built‑in app feature. Users can create a personal AI agent, choose an AI model, and via conversation ask the agent to research the market, analyze portfolios, devise strategies and place trades.

Robinhood said that since the Agentic Trading launch in May, more than 150,000 customers have opened Agentic Trading accounts, and AI agents are used nearly 30 million times per day with Robinhood tools. The new Robinhood Agents will broaden this capability so users unfamiliar with AI can create and use agents within the app.

The new system will use a separate Agentic Trading account, and the AI agent can only access funds allocated to that account. Users may opt to require manual approval for each trade, which is enabled by default. Robinhood will also roll out a feature called Loops that lets users set strategies as continuously running instructions, such as checking the market daily and automatically placing orders when conditions are met, even while the user sleeps.

Robinhood is also launching AI Agent Apps that give agents access to more professional market data and analytics tools. The first batch and subsequent additions include eleven data and tool providers such as Unusual Whales, Nasdaq (NDAQ-US), SpotGamma, Wendy, Quiver Quantitative, Token Terminal, Visual Crossing, SkyFi, Narravance, and upcoming additions Carbon Arc and Fiscal.ai. Monthly fees for some tools range from $5 to $30, and all AI Agent Apps come with a one‑month free trial.

Robinhood also announced it will expand trading hours, planning to open weekend 24‑hour trading for select US stocks and ETFs early next year, pending regulatory review. Weekend trading will start with a curated list of stocks and ETFs, will be available to all account types, and the underlying trading infrastructure will be provided by the alternative trading system Bruce ATS.

The plan extends Robinhood’s 24‑Hour Market launched in 2023. Currently users can trade hundreds of stocks and ETFs from 8 p.m. ET on Sunday to 8 p.m. ET on Friday. Reuters noted that about ten months after introducing all‑day weekday trading, Robinhood said non‑traditional session volume can account for up to 25 % of daily volume on the busiest days. The upcoming weekend trading marks Robinhood’s first extension of trading services into the weekend.

Robinhood said the initial weekend trading will follow a selected‑securities model and will roll out after regulatory clearance. The market acknowledges that non‑traditional session liquidity can be lower, spreads wider and price uncertainty higher, so the actual coverage and launch timing will depend on regulatory progress.

Beyond AI and extended hours, Robinhood announced perpetual crypto futures. Qualified US customers will soon be able to trade BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, ADA, LINK and HYPE perpetual futures directly in the app. These contracts have no expiry; BTC and ETH perpetuals can be leveraged up to 10 ×, while the other assets allow up to 3 × leverage.

The perpetual futures are offered by Robinhood Derivatives through Bitstamp. Robinhood said it will charge a fee of one basis point (0.01 %) per trade through the end of the year and will provide stop‑loss, take‑profit, real‑time liquidation prices and risk‑alert features.

Robinhood will also expand its predictive‑market products with Earnings Contracts tied to corporate earnings. These contracts, delivered via Cboe, will let eligible users with options‑trading permission trade on specific financial or operational metrics of a company, such as beating earnings expectations, hitting revenue targets or crossing a defined financial threshold.

Unlike traditional equity options, settlement of these binary KPI contracts is based not on the stock price but on the specific metric disclosed in the company’s filing with the SEC. Each contract pays up to $1. Robinhood and Cboe said no contract fees will be charged through year‑end, though the product remains subject to regulatory review.

In other trading features, Robinhood will extend options trading hours for popular symbols from 7:30 a.m. to 4:15 p.m. starting in October, an estimated 35 % increase in overall trading time. The firm will also launch stock OCO (One‑Cancels‑the‑Other) orders in October, allowing users to set simultaneous profit‑taking and stop‑loss prices; the options version is slated for early next year.

Additionally, Robinhood expects to let eligible margin customers select up to 4 × intraday buying power next month, up from the current 2 × maximum. The company is also adding pre‑close push notifications and an app reminder at first use.

Robinhood Social will expand from its early‑year testing phase to all qualified US customers. New features include sharing crypto and stock charts, portfolio allocations and P&L, and a real‑time earnings feature slated for Q3 earnings season that lets users watch earnings calls and trade during the webcast.

This sweeping product expansion reflects Robinhood’s ongoing shift toward serving active traders. The company aims to bring AI agents, all‑day trading, perpetual futures, earnings contracts and a suite of professional data tools—traditionally found at hedge funds, quant shops and large institutions—into a retail investing platform.

However, Robinhood cautions that AI agents may misinterpret commands, use incomplete or outdated information, or execute trades in ways users did not anticipate. If users disable manual approval, agents can place orders without per‑trade confirmation; once Loops are active, they may automatically create, modify or cancel trades even when the user is not in the app or is sleeping, so users bear all resulting profit‑and‑loss and automation‑rule responsibility.

Robinhood also notes that extending trading hours can bring lower liquidity, higher volatility, wider spreads and greater price uncertainty, and that AI trading raises issues around third‑party large‑language‑model data policies, regulation, privacy and cybersecurity. Weekend stock trading still awaits regulatory approval, and the rollout timing and eligible‑customer scope for AI agents and other new products may shift due to regulatory or technical factors.

items.title: 小摩轉「戰術性看多」美股！五大理由曝光：科技、半導體成核心布局
paras: 摩根大通（JPMorgan）機構市場情報交易台（Market Intel Desk）近期將美股短線觀點，從「戰術性謹慎／中性」調整為「戰術性看多」，並認為當前市場風險報酬比已明顯改善。
根據最新報告，該交易台此次轉向主要建立在5項因素，包括宏觀基本面優於預期、消費者展現韌性、企業獲利預期可能偏低、債券殖利率趨於穩定，以及技術面改善。
策略方面，該交易台也調整原本的多那斯達克100指數（NDX）、空羅素2000指數（RTY）配對交易，改以衍生品工具表達相關市場觀點。
摩根大通機構市場情報交易台上一次調整立場是在8月31日，當時由看多轉為「戰術性謹慎／中性」，考量因素包括聯準會（Fed）政策不確定性、部位配置、信用利差擴大、季節性因素，以及動能因子回落。
當時該團隊建議採取多NDX、空RTY的配對交易。
自8月底調整觀點以來，標普500指數大致持平，但上述多NDX／空RTY配對交易累計上漲逾8%，美股整體表現也優於其他主要市場。
在此背景下，該交易台如今重新轉向戰術性看多，顯示其認為短期市場風險與潛在報酬之間的條件已出現變化。

五大理由支撐美股短線看多

摩根大通交易台在最新報告中列出5項主要理由。
首先，宏觀基本面優於預期。最新初值PMI顯示經濟成長強於市場預期，可能進一步支撐就業、消費及企業獲利。
該團隊指出，標普500每股盈餘（EPS）成長與名目GDP增速的關聯更為密切，因此目前市場對企業獲利的預期可能相對保守。
其次，消費者韌性仍高於預期。儘管市場此前擔憂通膨及高利率可能壓抑消費，但實際消費數據持續優於預期，使「K型復甦」的相關假設受到挑戰；同時，勞動市場改善也持續支撐消費表現。
第三，企業獲利預期可能仍有上修空間。2026年第2季EPS成長率達52%，目前市場預估第3季約成長29%。摩根大通交易台認為，這項預測可能偏低，因標普500 11大產業目前均預期實現營收及EPS正成長。
第四，美債殖利率可能趨於穩定。摩根大通利率策略師Jay Barry預估，10年期美債殖利率未來1個月將從5.18%小幅升至5.20%，之後年底回落至5.05%。若殖利率波動降低，可能有助於緩解股市部分下行壓力。
第五，技術面持續改善。報告認為，季節性因素轉向有利，加上散戶投資人參與度可能提高，而目前整體市場持倉相對輕盈，為股市提供進一步上行空間。

PCE、就業數據與AI題材成近期焦點

除了基本面因素外，摩根大通交易台也列出近期可能影響市場的數據及事件。
通膨方面，本週將公布PCE及ISM製造業數據，其中ISM製造業價格支付分項被視為重要的前瞻性通膨指標，服務業價格支付分項的影響則更為明顯。若數據顯示通膨壓力高於預期，可能造成殖利率曲線出現熊市平坦化。
後續CPI將於10月14日公布，聯準會則預計於10月28日召開利率會議。
就業市場方面，若就業數據持續改善，將有助於強化經濟成長及消費的相關論述，但在目前市場定價下，強勁就業數據也可能重新推升升息預期，形成「好消息就是壞消息」的市場反應。
AI題材則仍是市場關注焦點。Meta旗下Muse發布，以及本週OpenAI開發者日、美光科技（MU）財報，都將成為AI產業後續發展的重要觀察窗口。

科技仍是核心多頭　半導體、「美股七巨頭」受關注

在投資策略上，科技產業仍是摩根大通交易台的核心多頭部位，但團隊不再建議透過放空RTY進行對沖。
報告指出，若油價及殖利率進一步走低，可能引發RTY軋空，因此相關風險敞口較適合透過衍生品工具表達。
科技產業內部則可能出現進一步分化，摩根大通預期半導體及「美股七巨頭」成分股有機會跑贏整體科技產業。
軟體股目前尚未形成市場共識，但人氣正在逐步累積，被該團隊視為非共識性的看多機會；至於AI題材，團隊仍認為其具延續性，建議持續持有相關曝險。
科技以外，摩根大通認為周期性產業若要出現持續性反彈，需要看到殖利率曲線轉向牛市陡峭化。在非AI領域中，銀行股則受到關注，原因包括經濟重啟、殖利率曲線可能陡峭化，以及資本市場前景改善。
對於房地產、電信及公用事業等利率敏感型產業，該交易台認為雖可能參與軋空行情，但整體而言仍可能持續落後標普500，AI相關標的除外。
此外，報告指出，若美伊達成協議，可能推動歐股及RTY大幅上漲；航空、汽車、郵輪、非必需消費及飯店等疫情後復甦題材也值得關注，並建議優先透過選擇權布局。

轉多仍伴隨風險　聯準會政策成關鍵變數

儘管短線觀點轉向看多，摩根大通交易台仍列出多項中長期風險。
其中包括債券市場是否低估此次聯準會升息周期的終點。若經濟如初值PMI所顯示，以5%的實質成長速度擴張，同時通膨壓力持續、就業市場改善並推升薪資通膨，聯準會可能需要採取更積極的升息路徑。
市場另外也需觀察，是否開始反映聯準會在某次會議升息50個基點的可能性，以及農產品通膨何時傳導至核心通膨。
此外，科技產業之外能否形成其他具持續性的結構性投資機會，也是該交易台列出的重要問題。上述因素將影響此次戰術性轉多能否延續。

items.title: 美光財報周三登場！ 若利多齊聚 歷史顯示股價能大漲
items.title_en: Micron Earnings Arrive Wednesday! If All Bullish Factors Align, History Shows the Stock Can Soar
paras: 人工智慧(AI)交易寵兒美光(MU-US)將在周三(30日)盤後公布財報，巴隆周刊(Barron’s)報導，要想看到股價重演大幅上漲的歷史，需要看到有利財報的因素到齊。
美光股價周二隨其他晶片股走高，收盤上漲1%至每股1065.08美元
。美光是AI熱潮下的主要受益者之一，過去一年來股價累積大漲近550%。
美光預定公布的財報可能不只影響美光，也可能改變其他多檔股票的市場情緒，關鍵在於財報釋出的訊號，是否能讓投資人看清未來AI支出的走向。
過去幾年，美光財報公布後曾出現相當驚人的漲勢，但也曾大幅下跌，整體而言可說漲跌各半。

11季財報後單日表現 漲跌各半

檢視從2024會計年度算起的11個季度以來，美光在財報公布隔日的股價表現，為五次上漲、六次下跌。其中有幾次的波動幅度相當劇烈：例如2025會計年度第1季財報公布後，美光股價重挫16.2%，但今年6月公布最近一次財報後，股價大漲15.7%，創下史上最佳的財報後單日表現。
從技術面來看，目前美光的股價位置相當有利。周二收盤價高於20日、50日與200日簡單移動平均線，分別為1000美元、945美元與665美元。當股價高於短期移動平均線，且短期均線又高於長期均線時，通常被視為股價動能偏正面的訊號。

分析師看好財報 記憶體價格成關鍵

從基本面來看，分析師也對美光即將公布的財報抱持樂觀態度。儘管市場仍擔心AI需求能否持續，但分析師表示，晶片價格看起來依然強勁，這正是美光業務的重要驅動因素。
Wedbush分析師周一發布報告指出：「晶片價格應會顯著優於美光ˊ最近期財測所假設的水準。」該券商重申美光「優於大盤」評級，目標價為1400美元。
分析師說：「儘管我們將預估值上修至略高於公司先前財測區間的高標，但我們認為記憶體價格走勢顯示，未來仍有進一步調升的空間。」
摩根大通(JPM-US)分析師周一則表示：「預料在持續的價格動能帶動下，美光財報將再次優於預期並上修財測。」
摩根大通給予美光「優於大盤」評級，目標價1540美元。分析師說：「在記憶體市場結構性供應緊俏的背景下，目前基本面仍具建設性，且仍有多項因素可能推動財報優於預期和調升財測。」
paras_en: AI‑driven chip darling Micron (MU‑US) will release its earnings after the market on Wednesday (the 30th). Barron’s reports that to see a repeat of the stock’s historic big jumps, all the favorable earnings factors need to be present.
Micron’s share price rose 1% on Tuesday, keeping pace with other chip stocks, closing at $1,065.08 per share.
Micron is one of the main beneficiaries of the AI boom, having rallied nearly 550% over the past year.
The upcoming earnings could affect not only Micron but also sentiment toward many other stocks; the key is whether the earnings signal lets investors see the future trajectory of AI spending.
In recent years Micron’s post‑earnings moves have been striking—sometimes soaring, sometimes plunging—with overall gains and losses roughly split 50‑50.

Looking at the 11 quarters since the start of fiscal 2024, Micron’s stock moved up on five earnings days and down on six. Some swings were extreme: after FY2025 Q1 results the stock fell 16.2%, while after the most recent June release it jumped 15.7%, the best single‑day post‑earnings gain on record.

Technically, Micron’s price is in a favorable spot. Tuesday’s close was above its 20‑day, 50‑day and 200‑day simple moving averages, which sit at $1,000, $945 and $665 respectively. When the price is above the short‑term averages and those averages are above the long‑term average, it is usually taken as a bullish momentum signal.

Fundamentally, analysts are optimistic about the upcoming earnings. Although the market still worries about the sustainability of AI demand, analysts say chip prices remain strong, which is a key driver for Micron’s business.

Wedbush analysts wrote on Monday that “chip prices are likely to be significantly higher than the levels assumed in Micron’s latest earnings guidance.” The firm reiterated a “outperform” rating on Micron with a target price of $1,400.
One analyst added, “While we are nudging our estimates slightly above the company’s prior guidance range, we believe the trajectory of memory prices still leaves room for further upside.”
JPMorgan (JPM‑US) analysts said on Monday, “Given the continued price momentum, we expect Micron’s earnings to again beat expectations and prompt an upgrade to guidance.”

JPMorgan rates Micron “outperform” with a target price of $1,540, noting that “with structural tightness in memory supply, the fundamentals remain constructive and several factors could drive earnings above expectations and higher guidance.”
